{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip;]'' this rich merchant&mdash;guy named Danager&mdash;laughed and said if I drove the Norries off, he'd give me the deed to one of his breweries on Clendor. That got everybody laughing at me&mdash;I think I also got offered the Imperial Palace and the Sceptre of Nopachi&mdash;but I didn't mind.|Lando Calrissian, ''Oral History of the New Republic''|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sceptre of Nopachi''' was an [[Scepter/Legends|artifact]]<ref name="EGTW" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Nopachi system/Legends|Nopachi system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' dates the [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]] to five [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] claimed to the patrons of a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]] that he could drive off the [[Norulac Freebooters]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang that was causing trouble for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. In response, the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Gathal Danager]] laughingly promised him the deed to [[Unidentified brewery|one]] of his breweries. Other patrons then joined in on the ridiculing of Calrissian's claim, and, in an interview with the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] that was included in the work ''[[Oral History of the New Republic]]'' [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Calrissian noted his recollection that at that point he was also offered the Sceptre of Nopachi for driving off the pirates.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sceptre of Nopachi was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
